about.description: Set of tools for reading and processing spatial data. The aim is to supply the workflow to create thematic maps. This package also facilitates 'tmap', the package for visualizing thematic maps.

name: r-tmap
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "4.4-1" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-tmap
  version: "{{ version|replace("-", "_") }}"

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/tmap_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/tmap/tmap_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: cd3c0954ab881f6dcecaec888a0aa50cf855c9fece817960eeb9ab9556d0ccc3

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-base64enc
    - r-classint >=0.4_3
    - r-cli
    - r-cols4all >=0.10
    - r-data.table
    - r-htmltools
    - r-htmlwidgets
    - r-leafem >=0.2.4
    - r-leafgl
    - r-leaflegend
    - r-leaflet >=2.0.2
    - r-leafsync
    - r-maptiles
    - r-rlang
    - r-s2
    - r-servr
    - r-sf >=0.9_3
    - r-stars >=0.4_2
    - r-tmaptools >=3.1
    - r-units >=0.6_1
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-base64enc
    - r-classint >=0.4_3
    - r-cli
    - r-cols4all >=0.10
    - r-data.table
    - r-htmltools
    - r-htmlwidgets
    - r-leafem >=0.2.4
    - r-leafgl
    - r-leaflegend
    - r-leaflet >=2.0.2
    - r-leafsync
    - r-maptiles
    - r-rlang
    - r-s2
    - r-servr
    - r-sf >=0.9_3
    - r-stars >=0.4_2
    - r-tmaptools >=3.1
    - r-units >=0.6_1

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('tmap')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('tmap')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://r-tmap.github.io/tmap/
  dev_url: https://github.com/r-tmap/tmap
  doc_url: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/tmap/tmap.pdf
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  summary: Thematic maps are geographical maps in which spatial data distributions are visualized. This package offers a flexible, layer-based, and easy to use approach to create thematic maps, such as choropleths and bubble maps.
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3
  description: Set of tools for reading and processing spatial data. The aim is to supply the workflow to create thematic maps. This package also facilitates 'tmap', the package for visualizing thematic maps.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - mxr-conda
    - agcopenhaver
    - oblute
    - tata17
